name: Ashnod
description: An artificer said in one legend to have carved the sylex from a qadir's skullcap.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
timeline.quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

relations.note: Ashnod was an artificer who worked for Mishra.
relations.quote: Some artificer who worked for Mishra during the war

pages_say.description: An artificer who worked for Mishra and made transmogrants.
An artificer thought to run a school of magic and artifice with a mage called Duck; Tawnos thinks of her before disappearing.
An artificer said in one legend to have carved the sylex from a qadir's skullcap.
